columns.name: RECTYPE
columns.description: control field with a constant value.

columns.name: POLNO
columns.description: unique identifier for the policy.

columns.name: PRODCD
columns.description: categorical code representing the type of plan.

columns.name: COMMDT
columns.description: the date the policy commenced, in YYYYMMDD format.

columns.name: STATCD
columns.description: categorical code indicating the current status of the policy.

columns.name: EXITDT
columns.description: the date the policy exited, in YYYYMMDD format. Conditionally populated.

columns.name: EXITRSN
columns.description: categorical code indicating the reason for policy exit. Conditionally populated.

columns.name: XA08
columns.description: structural filler, no business meaning.

columns.name: UNPDDT
columns.description: the date from which premiums have been unpaid, in YYYYMMDD format. Conditionally populated.

columns.name: SCHNO
columns.description: unique identifier for the scheme. Conditionally populated.

columns.name: SCHNM
columns.description: the name of the scheme, free text. Conditionally populated.

columns.name: PREMAMT
columns.description: the amount of premium, in decimal format.

columns.name: PREMFRQ
columns.description: categorical code indicating how often premiums are paid.

columns.name: XA14
columns.description: structural filler, no business meaning.

columns.name: SUMASSD
columns.description: the total amount assured, in integer format.

columns.name: REGION
columns.description: control field with a constant value.

columns.name: MBRNAME
columns.description: the member's name, free text.

columns.name: BIRTHDT
columns.description: the member's birth date, in YYYYMMDD format.

columns.name: NINO
columns.description: the National Insurance number, free text.

columns.name: PCODE
columns.description: the member's postcode, free text.

columns.name: COVSTDT
columns.description: the date coverage starts, in YYYYMMDD format.

columns.name: XA22
columns.description: categorical code indicating the traceability status.

columns.name: LOYBONUS
columns.description: calculated field representing the loyalty bonus, in decimal format.

columns.name: EXTPNPCT
columns.description: calculated field representing the exit penalty percentage, in decimal format.

columns.name: CUSTID
columns.description: a reference identifier for the customer, free text.

rules: Each policy is uniquely identified by the Policy Number (POLNO).
Plan Type (PRODCD) and Policy Status (STATCD) are categorical codes with specific decodes.
Exit Date (EXITDT) and Exit Reason (EXITRSN) are conditionally populated based on policy status.
Premium Frequency (PREMFRQ) indicates how often premiums are paid.
Loyalty Bonus (LOYBONUS) and Exit Penalty Percent (EXTPNPCT) are calculated fields.
